sources.claim: MITRE ATT&CK says Bazar reportedly has ties to TrickBot campaigns.
Google TAG says BazarLoader delivery and other indicators confirmed a relationship between EXOTIC LILY and Russian cybercrime operations tracked as WIZARD SPIDER, FIN12, and DEV-0193.
Proofpoint reports BazaLoader activity in the same ransomware initial-access ecosystem as The Trick and other loader families.

curator_note: Modeled as a reported ecosystem relationship. Public sources support campaign and operator-adjacent ties to TrickBot-era operations, but not direct malware lineage.
confidence_reason: MITRE, Google TAG, and Proofpoint independently place BazarLoader in TrickBot/Wizard Spider or adjacent ransomware initial-access ecosystems.
